# Legacy RNNoise backend

This is the minimal RNNoise source set from commit
`6cbfd53eb348a8d394e0757b4025c6ded34eb2b6` (v0.1.1). CubicSDR builds it with
prefixed symbols so it can coexist with the current RNNoise backend.

It powers the **Mid** noise-reduction mode, which is less aggressive with weak
narrowband radio speech. See `COPYING` for its upstream BSD license.
